text: At its meeting held March 10, 2021, City Council appointed Allison Mendes to the CreateTO Board for a term of office from March 11, 2021 to March 10, 2025 and until a successor is appointed. This new appointment fills the position previously held by Dino Chiesa who resigned on November 26, 2020.
The Board of Directors of CreateTO: 1. Received the item for information.
